attrs.caution: CLN2 disease has an approved enzyme replacement therapy (cerliponase alfa) because TPP1 is a soluble lysosomal enzyme that can be supplied from outside the cell. That success does not automatically transfer to CLN5 disease: whether CLN5 can be replaced the same way is unproven.

source.label: CLN5 disease
source.summary: A very rare inherited childhood brain disease that causes vision loss, seizures and loss of skills. There is no approved treatment yet.

target.label: CLN2 disease
target.summary: A form of Batten disease that starts in toddlers with seizures and loss of skills. An enzyme replacement therapy is approved.

context.quote: [MOCK] Indicated for children with CLN2 disease (TPP1 deficiency).
